name: stage1_overfit_smoke
_comment: FORMAL STAGE 1 (sanity). 8 train images, 200 epochs, lr 1e-3. Purpose:
prove the model and the two-term loss actually reduce the objective and
that gradients reach every refiner parameter, BEFORE the full 454-image
run. Its single pre-registered validation node is the FINAL epoch (200):
GO_NO_GO pre-registered no mid-stage node for stage 1, and adding one now,
before any epoch is executed, would be a new declaration, so it is not
done. Stage 1 cannot be promoted on a partial curve.
The loss block below is a verbatim mirror of configs/refiner_v1.json;
refiner.losses.assert_frozen_objective fails closed on any drift.
